verdict.line: You lose if you charge W (Path Maker) into a landed Infernal Chains and eat the follow-up Q swings; you win if you trade the moment his W is down and stack Q (Ntofo Strikes) into the shockwave pull.

brief.thesis: This is a genuinely even lane: 46.4% K'Sante win rate over 1836 games, with K'Sante holding the solo-kill edge. The matchup is decided by whether you charge W (Path Maker) into Aatrox's Deathbringer Stance proc or around it, and whether you itemize grievous wounds fast enough to outlast his passive and E (Umbral Dash) sustain.

theirWindow.when: Right after Aatrox lands W root
theirWindow.what: Infernal Chains drags you to center if you don't walk out, and he follows immediately with Q (The Darkin Blade) swings and an E (Umbral Dash) heal-on-hit. Pop E (Footwork)'s shield for the follow-up swings rather than using it to chase.

yourWindow.when: While Aatrox's W is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Infernal Chains sits at 20/18/16/14/12s with no other root on his kit, so step up and trade freely. Land two Q (Ntofo Strikes) hits to trigger the stack-2 shockwave pull, then chain into W (Path Maker)'s stun.

powerCurve.note: W root threatens an early all-in
full tank kit, gold diff decides

start.why: The run data shows it over Doran's Shield 82.1% of the time; the omnivamp keeps you even through Aatrox's Q poke and passive Deathbringer Stance procs without forcing a recall.

boots.why: Run 78.6% of games; flattens the physical poke from his Q swings and empowered autos so trades cost him more than they cost you.

core.why: Grievous wounds early directly cuts the healing Aatrox gets from his passive and E (Umbral Dash)'s on-damage heal, which is the core of his dueling power.
Adds a slow proc on top of Q (Ntofo Strikes), letting you layer CC into the W (Path Maker) stun instead of relying on it alone.
Completes the anti-heal and adds reflect damage, making his Q-swing all-ins actively unprofitable.
Stacking resistances carry you into extended skirmishes once laning is over, where this exact path hits 54.9% over 122 games.

situational.when: he's building enough lifesteal that one Thornmail proc isn't shutting his sustain down
their composition shifts toward heavy magic burst instead of Aatrox's physical damage

runes.keystoneWhy: Your Q (Ntofo Strikes) procs every 3.5s align with Grasp's attack-timer, converting sustained trades into permanent health that outlasts his short-cooldown E (Umbral Dash) poke.

summoners.why: Run in 70.6% of games at 46.9% win rate; Teleport lets you reset after even trades and keep wave/plate pressure since neither side has a reliable kill pattern without a cooldown misplay.

playing.title: Trade only after Q stacks
playing.detail: Land two Q (Ntofo Strikes) hits to trigger the shockwave pull before committing to a full trade; it locks Aatrox in range for your W (Path Maker) stun chain.

playing.title: Punish W cooldown windows
playing.detail: The moment Infernal Chains is used on minions or whiffs, step up and trade; he has no other root to stop your engage.

playing.title: Charge W into incoming bursts
playing.detail: Path Maker's charge-up phase reduces damage taken, so start it as his Deathbringer Stance (passive) proc or a Q swing lands to blunt the hit.

playing.title: Hold E for the follow-up swings
playing.detail: Save Footwork's shield for the Q (The Darkin Blade) swings Aatrox chains after landing W, rather than spending it early to extend a trade.

playing.title: Rush Bramble Vest for anti-heal
playing.detail: Grievous wounds is the single highest-impact item here since it cuts both his passive heal and his E (Umbral Dash) sustain at once.

playing.title: Respect his R takedown extension
playing.detail: All Out and World Ender share a 120/100/80/80/80s cooldown, but Aatrox's extends on a takedown - don't commit your R into a skirmish where he can pick off a squishy.

playing.title: Press your solo-kill advantage
playing.detail: K'Sante holds the measured solo-kill edge in this matchup, so look to all-in around level 6 or whenever his W is down rather than playing passively for an even lane.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, win rates, and pick rates are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the tactical reasoning behind them - cooldown windows, trade patterns, and itemization timing - is my own analysis.
